headline: Silverton Electronics signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Silverton Electronics announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.

headline: Silverton Electronics under fraud investigation over inflated invoices
body: Prosecutors are investigating Silverton Electronics over allegations of inflated invoicing to customers. The company denies wrongdoing, but two customers have paused orders.

headline: Silverton Electronics reports minor shipment delays at Curitiba plant
body: Silverton Electronics confirmed shipment delays of several days at its Curitiba plant due to a equipment maintenance backlog. The company said deliveries should normalize within weeks.

headline: Lenders flag covenant breach at Silverton Electronics, bankruptcy rumors grow
body: Lenders to Silverton Electronics have flagged a covenant breach and are negotiating a standstill. Market commentary has raised the possibility of insolvency proceedings.

headline: Silverton Electronics reports record quarterly revenue
body: Silverton Electronics reported revenue growth of 16% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Court freezes assets of Silverton Electronics amid insolvency petition
body: A court froze assets of Silverton Electronics after creditors filed an insolvency petition. Operations continue under court supervision.

headline: Analysts trim outlook for Silverton Electronics on softer demand
body: Two analysts lowered their outlook for Silverton Electronics, citing softer demand and rising input costs. No change to guidance has been announced.
